CAS — 196618-13-0 (oseltamivir); 204255-11-8 (osel- tamivir phosphate). ATC — J05AH02. ATC Vet — QJ05AH02. (oseltamivir) Adverse Effects The most commonly reported adverse effects associat- ed with oseltamivir treatment or prophylaxis in adults are nausea and vomiting, abdominal pain, bronchitis, insomnia, and vertigo. Diarrhoea, dizziness, headache, cough, and fatigue may occur, but many adverse ef- fects may be difficult to distinguish from the symptoms of influenza. Other adverse effects occurring less com- monly have included unstable angina, anaemia, pseu- domembranous colitis, pneumonia, pyrexia, and peri- tonsillar abscess.
